notes:
The marker file is «.ALB» (the owner's extension); «.l7n» markers still open

A marker is saved as <name>.ALB: the window's «save as» (a name without an extension, or typed «.alb», too), the batch
list and the command line LEVEL7 MTM uses. «.ALB» opens from the open window, by a double-click (the installer registers
it) and in every command. An older «.l7n» marker (the same content) still opens and is saved in place under its own
name: nothing is renamed. «info --json» says so (features: alb) and «export --help» names it, which LEVEL7 MTM reads
before it names a marker. The cutting files (PLT, ISO, DXF) keep their extensions.

ar: ملف الماركر صار بامتداد ALB؛ ملفات l7n القديمة تُفتح كما هي، وملفات القص PLT و ISO لم تتغير
